column5: text
Imagine being swallowed by a whale...
You're seconds away from becoming its next meal.
A shadow blocks out the sunlight.
You turn around.
A gigantic mouth rushes toward you...
And suddenly, you're surrounded by darkness.
You're inside the mouth of a humpback whale.
Water crashes against your body.
You can barely see anything.
You spot a faint glow near the edge and swim toward it.
But before you can reach the light...
The whale turns.
A powerful current throws you backward.
Your chance of escape is disappearing.
Your lungs begin to burn.
You desperately fight your way toward the opening.
Then the whale suddenly surges toward the surface.
You see sunlight.
You're almost free.
But a wall of water slams into you...
And sends you straight back into the darkness.
For a moment, you think it's over.
Then the whale opens its mouth.
Water explodes into the air as it breaks the surface.
You're swept out with the current and thrown into the ocean.
You tumble underwater, unable to tell which way is up.
Your lungs are screaming.
You kick as hard as you can...
And finally break through the surface.
You gasp for air.
You survived.
You look around.
The whale is gone.
But something is floating beside you.
A broken piece of your diving equipment.
Your air supply is damaged.
Then you hear a deep, distant sound beneath the water.
The ocean around you begins to ripple.
Something enormous is rising from the depths.
A giant shape emerges beneath you.
It's a sperm whale.
It isn't trying to swallow you.
It's hunting something much deeper.
Then you see what it's chasing...
A shadow far larger than the whale itself.
And suddenly...
The sperm whale turns and flees.
